description: Rory starts Yale while Lorelai works toward opening the Dragonfly Inn, forcing both women to build new routines beyond the life they had previously shared almost completely.

s04e01.description: Lorelai and Rory return from Europe to discover Rory has only two days before Yale orientation, while Luke reveals that his cruise with Nicole ended in an unexpected marriage.

s04e02.description: Moving Rory into Yale becomes an all-day operation, especially after Paris appears as a roommate and Rory’s first burst of homesickness brings Lorelai back for a dorm-wide takeout night.

s04e03.description: Lorelai and Sookie take catering jobs to finance the Dragonfly and survive a children’s fantasy-themed party, while Emily unexpectedly redecorates Rory’s Yale common room.

s04e04.description: Rory returns home and awkwardly encounters Dean on the eve of his wedding, while Lorelai and Sookie struggle to secure the permits needed to begin work on the Dragonfly.

s04e05.description: Rory attempts her first date since Jess and discovers how awkward starting over can be, while Lorelai invites Luke to revive movie night and worries about the inn’s designer connection to Emily.

s04e06.description: Emily hires Lorelai and Sookie to cater the launch of Richard’s new business and overwhelms them with demands, while Rory’s increasingly chaotic dorm makes studying nearly impossible.

s04e07.description: Stars Hollow stages a living-art festival that tests Lorelai’s nerves, while Sookie prepares for a home birth, Lane’s band finds a new guitarist and Luke agrees to reconsider divorcing Nicole.

s04e08.description: Rory’s brutally honest ballet review provokes the dancer she criticized, while Jason maneuvers his way into Friday dinner and Luke’s resumed relationship with Nicole visibly unsettles Lorelai.

s04e09.description: At the Harvard-Yale game, Emily learns Richard has secretly met former fiancée Pennilyn every year, while Lorelai finally dates Jason and Rory discovers Paris kissing Professor Asher Fleming.

s04e10.description: Rory struggles with Paris dating one of her professors while earning a place on the Yale Daily News, and Lorelai’s relationship with Jason deepens under a promise to hide it from her parents.

s04e11.description: Lorelai and Luke unite against Stars Hollow’s relentlessly restored church bells, while Lane’s band lands a New York gig and Rory confronts a classmate over mixed signals about dating.

s04e12.description: Liz and Jess return to Stars Hollow as Lane temporarily settles into Yale life, while Paris must choose between Jamie and Asher and Lorelai’s financial strain becomes harder to hide.

s04e13.description: The Firelight Festival brings Liz and her new boyfriend T.J. into Luke’s orbit, while Jess repairs his car, clashes with those around him and abruptly tells Rory he loves her before leaving.

s04e14.description: Lorelai struggles to finance the Dragonfly as Rory buckles under an overloaded Yale schedule, and both reach breaking points while repeatedly failing to connect with each other.

s04e15.description: A shared day at the mall exposes Emily’s loneliness in her deteriorating marriage, while Luke lends Lorelai the money needed to finish the Dragonfly and Rory glimpses Dean’s unhappy married life.

s04e16.description: Trix dies suddenly, leaving Lorelai to organize the funeral after Emily discovers an old letter urging Richard not to marry her and refuses to handle her mother-in-law’s final arrangements.

s04e17.description: Rory and Paris join their roommates for spring break in Florida, while Lorelai bails Luke out of jail after his furious reaction to discovering Nicole with another man.

s04e18.description: Floyd exposes Lorelai and Jason’s secret relationship and threatens Richard’s new company with a lawsuit, while Rory’s criticism of Lindsay is overheard and Dean’s marriage grows increasingly strained.

s04e19.description: Richard protects himself by turning against Jason, leading Lorelai to end the relationship when Jason decides to sue her father, while Emily quietly moves out of the Gilmore house.

s04e20.description: Liz returns to announce her wedding and Jess reluctantly comes back for it, while a self-help exercise finally makes Luke recognize that the relationship he wants is with Lorelai.

s04e21.description: At Liz and T.J.’s wedding, Luke and Lorelai share a revealing dance that leads him to ask her out, while Rory rejects Jess’s plea to leave with him and turns to Dean for help.

s04e22.description: The Dragonfly’s trial opening brings Luke and Lorelai to their first kiss, while Rory sleeps with the still-married Dean and Emily and Richard finally acknowledge that they have separated.
